answer: Group-escrow coordination fee: each agent joins a jetty pool by posting a small deposit that is released only when the pool's joint outputs match an external echo of prior commitments. A single mismatched member forfeits the whole pool's deposit, so an attacker must fund N sybils per fake identity and risk losing all deposits on one detection. Each fake identity costs that full pool loss plus the saffron-tier fee for pool re-entry.
